accountDeletion.title: Permanently delete your account
accountDeletion.intro: This permanently deletes your DarSak account and its associated personal data. You will lose access immediately.
accountDeletion.teacherWarning: Deleting a teacher account also removes every group you own, its lessons and recordings/files, and all student access and enrollments in those groups. Students will no longer be able to open those resources.
accountDeletion.historyWarning: A limited record of administrative access and decisions may remain for operational accountability. Emails already delivered cannot be recalled.
accountDeletion.acknowledge: I understand this is permanent and have reviewed what will be deleted.
accountDeletion.googleReady: If you have returned from Google verification, confirm below. The deletion service checks the verification before continuing.
accountDeletion.pending: Deletion is in progress. Your account is not yet confirmed as deleted.
accountDeletion.pendingDetails: Cleanup can take time. You can retry here; this request will not be reported as complete until cleanup finishes.
accountDeletion.unavailable: Account deletion is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
accountDeletion.suspended: This account is suspended. Contact an administrator for help with deletion.
accountDeletion.goodbye: Your DarSak account and associated files were permanently deleted.
accountDeletion.googleError: Google verification could not be completed. Please verify again.
